descriptionChirho: The Greek proper noun Φίλιππος ('lover of horses'), used in the NT for several individuals: Philip the apostle (John 1:43-48, 6:5-7, 12:21-22, 14:8-9), Philip the evangelist/deacon (Acts 6:5, 8:5-40, 21:8), Philip the tetrarch son of Herod (Matt 14:3, Mark 6:17, Luke 3:1, 3:19). All 37 occurrences are the same proper name in various grammatical cases. S78605 (32x, nominative/accusative/genitive/dative/vocative singular) and S78606 (5x, genitive singular in 'of Philip' constructions) differ only in syntactic function. Translations uniformly transliterate: Spanish 'Phílippos,' Arabic 'فيلبس,' Hindi 'फिलिप्पुस,' Korean '빌립,' Swahili 'Filipo.' No semantic distinction exists between the clusters.
